sn12.25:1.2: atha kho āyasmā bhūmijo sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi
sn12.25:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nīsīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā bhūmijo āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca
sn12.25:2.1: santāvuso sārīputta eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññapenti
sn12.25:2.2: santi panāvuso sārīputta eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādāparakataṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññapenti
sn12.25:2.3: santāvuso sārīputta eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkatañca parakatañca sukhadukkhaṃ paññapenti
sn12.25:2.4: santi panāvuso sāriputta eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayaṃkāraṃ aparakāraṃ adhicca samuppannaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññapenti.
sn12.25:2.5: idha no āvuso sāriputta bhagavā kiṃvādī kimakkhāyī
sn12.25:2.6: kathaṃ byākaramānā ca mayaṃ vuttavādino ceva bhagavato assāma na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkheyyāma dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākareyyāma na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgaccheyyāti.
sn12.25:3.1: paṭiccasamuppannaṃ kho āvuso sukhadukkhaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā
sn12.25:3.4: iti vadaṃ vuttavādī ceva bhagavato assa na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkheyya dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākareyya na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgaccheyya.
sn12.25:4.1: tatrāvuso ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññapenti tadapi phassapaccayā.
sn12.25:4.4: yepi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayaṃkāraṃ aparakāraṃ adhicca samuppannaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññapenti tadapi phassapaccayā.
sn12.25:5.1: tatrāvuso ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññapenti te vata aññatra phassā paṭisaṃvedayantīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
sn12.25:5.4: yepi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayaṃkāraṃ aparakāraṃ adhicca samuppannaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññapenti te vata aññatra phassā paṭisaṃvedayantīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti.
sn12.25:6.1: assosi kho āyasmā ānando āyasmato sāriputtassa āyasmatā bhūmijena saddhiṃ imaṃ kathāsallāpaṃ.
sn12.25:6.2: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
sn12.25:6.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando yāvatako āyasmato sāriputtassa āyasmatā bhūmijena saddhiṃ ahosi kathāsallāpo taṃ sabbaṃ bhagavato ārocesi.
sn12.25:7.1: sādhu sādhu ānanda yathātaṃ sāriputto ca sammā byākaramāno byākareyya.
sn12.25:7.2: paṭiccasamuppannaṃ kho ānanda sukhadukkhaṃ vuttaṃ mayā
sn12.25:7.5: iti vadaṃ vuttavādī ceva me assa na ca maṃ abhūtena abbhācikkheyya dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākareyya na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgaccheyya.
sn12.25:8.1: tatrānanda ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññapenti tadapi phassapaccayā.
sn12.25:8.4: yepi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayaṃkāraṃ aparakāraṃ adhicca samuppannaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññapenti tadapi phasusa paccayā.
sn12.25:9.1: tatrānanda ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññapenti te vata aññatra phassā paṭisaṃvedayantīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
sn12.25:9.4: yepi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayaṃkāraṃ aparakāraṃ adhicca samuppannaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññapenti te vata aññatra phassā paṭisaṃvedayantīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
sn12.25:10.1: kāye vā hānanda sati kāyasañcetanāhetu uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ
sn12.25:10.2: vācāyaṃ vā hānanda sati vacīsañcetanāhetu uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ
sn12.25:10.3: mane vā hānanda sati manosañcetanāhetu uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ. avijjāpaccayāva
sn12.25:11.1: sāmaṃ vā taṃ ānanda kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti yaṃpaccayāyataṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
sn12.25:11.2: pare vāyataṃ ānanda kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti yaṃpaccayāyataṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
sn12.25:11.3: sampajāno vā taṃ ānanda kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti yaṃpaccayāyataṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
sn12.25:11.4: asampajāno vā taṃ ānanda kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti yaṃpaccayāyataṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
sn12.25:12.1: sāmaṃ vā taṃ ānanda vacīsaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti yaṃpaccayāyataṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukha dukkhaṃ.
sn12.25:12.2: pare vāyataṃ ānanda vacīsaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti yaṃpaccayāyataṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
sn12.25:12.4: asampajāno vā taṃ ānanda vacīsaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti yaṃpaccayāyataṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
sn12.25:13.1: sāmaṃ vā taṃ ānanda manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti yaṃpaccayāyataṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
sn12.25:13.2: pare vāyataṃ ānanda manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti yaṃpaccayāyataṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
sn12.25:13.4: asampajāno vā taṃ ānanda manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti yaṃpaccayāyataṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
sn12.25:14.2: avijjāya tveva ānanda asesavirāganirodhā so kāyo na hoti yaṃpaccayāyataṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ. sā vācā na hoti yaṃpaccayāyataṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ. so mano na hoti yaṃpaccayāyataṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
sn12.25:14.3: khettaṃ vā na hoti. vatthuṃ vā na hoti. āyatanaṃ vā na hoti. adhikaraṇaṃ taṃ vā na hoti yaṃpaccayāyataṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhanti.
